startup.name: Nomi
startup.description: A real time copilot for sales reps that listens to transcribed calls and suggests phrases on the spot from a custom playbook that adapts over time, for founder led sales through revenue operations teams. Pays: per seat monthly subscription from sales teams, claiming a 12 percent average close rate lift.

yc_acceptance.basis: The input file places Nomi in the Spring 2025 batch with the batch start as the as_of date, so acceptance is treated as already happened. The prior for a random applicant is about 1 percent (references/yc_acceptance.md), but conditional on being listed in the batch the residual doubt is only data error or a deferral. Seed odds below are conditional on being in YC.
yc_acceptance.why_it_fails: The only way the YC step fails here is a clerical error in the batch listing or a deferral to a later batch. Nomi was reported in the batch directory as of the as_of date, so the reason to say no has already been resolved in its favor.

anchors.source: python3 -I scripts/base_rates.py --calibration-only --industry B2B --years 2022-2025 (150 researched: seed 49% / 59% / 65%, series_a cond 26% n=74, series_b cond 16% n=19); seed cond known-only 59% (n=126); months_to_seed median 7 (p25 3, p75 15) from knowledge/tables/time_to_milestones.csv calibration sample
anchors.adjustment_reason: The anchor is the 59 percent ever rate for B2B 2022 to 2025 (Sales tag 73 percent but n=11). The window is 19 months from the Spring 2025 batch start, where about 80 percent of eventual seed raisers have raised (median 7 months, p75 about 15 to 20), giving about 0.47. Real time sales coaching is crowded and conversation intelligence is dominated by Gong, so I discount to 0.42, and in any case I give no lift over the anchor for a hot AI category. The number does not rank Nomi against others.

bands.rationale: Small post YC round of $1M to $3M, typically angels and a micro fund. This is the second most common outcome for a 2 to 5 person team with early pilots and no scaled revenue, and it is more likely here than in the winners test sample because press favours big rounds. The plain YC deal of about $500K does not count as seed in this forecast.
Institutional seed of $3M to $6M led by a seed fund. This is the center of the 2022 and later benchmark (median about $4.1M in our table) and of the 2026 confirmed raises (lower quartile $4.3M).

Larger institutional seed of $6M to $12M. Reachable if a design partner or demo produces competitive tension, as in the 2026 winners where the median confirmed raise was $6.0M, a sample that leans high.
Upside seed above $12M, reserved for a hot category with a standout team. Rare for a team this small and early.

ladder.why_it_fails: Nomi most likely misses the seed because real time sales assist has well funded competitors and incumbents: Winn.ai, Hyperbound, Second Nature and Spiky raised rounds before this batch, and Gong, Salesloft and Mindtickle add real time features. Wingman, the YC predecessor of this wedge, was acquired after a seed, and echo (founder led sales copilot) shut down. A team of 5 with a 12 percent claim and no named customers has to show growth in a few months.

anchors.source: python3 -I scripts/base_rates.py --calibration-only --industry B2B --years 2022-2025 (150 researched: seed 49% / 59% / 65%, series_a cond 26% n=74, series_b cond 16% n=19); series_a cond 26% (n=74) (ever); months_to_series_a median 29 from batch start (B2B 2022 to 2025, n=19)
anchors.adjustment_reason: The ever conditional rate for Series A is 26 percent for B2B but only 12 percent for the Sales tag (n=8), and the median time to A from batch start is 29 months. Inside 19 months and given a seed I put 0.08.

bands.rationale: Thin or small Series A, close to a large seed, for a company with some revenue but unproven repeatability. Current 2022 and later YC Series A lower quartile is $10.0M, so this is the thin end.
Typical Series A of $9M to $18M, matching the 2022 and later YC median of $14.15M (n=52) and public market medians near $17M.
Upside Series A with a clear ARR ramp; AI native companies have printed larger A rounds in 2025 and 2026 but these remain the minority.

ladder.why_it_fails: A Series A needs about $1M in recurring revenue from sales teams that churn tools fast, and real time coaching has latency and distraction problems that limit adoption. Investors will compare with Winn.ai and Gong. The likely stall is a seed with a few dozen small team customers and flat retention.

anchors.source: python3 -I scripts/base_rates.py --calibration-only --industry B2B --years 2022-2025: series_b cond 16% (n=19) ever, lower 2% known-only
anchors.adjustment_reason: The window is 19 months, and Series B needs a median of 46 months from batch start (all eras, n=510 in time_to_milestones.csv; B2B 2022 to 2025 median 26 months on n=3, right censored). The probability is a floor for a fast outlier, far below the 16 percent ever rate, because only a company that raised both a seed and an A inside the window can get here.

bands.rationale: Thin Series B or extension, near the 2022 and later lower quartile of $25M.
Typical Series B, around the YC 2022 and later median of $37M (n=22).
Upside Series B on breakout growth, in line with the few 2022 and later B valuations near $775M.

ladder.why_it_fails: A Series B inside the 19 month window requires an A early and breakout ARR growth, which sales copilots rarely show; Wingman never reached a B and Demodesk took years. The floor covers only an outlier.

anchors.source: Series C cond is 0% of n=3 in the B2B 2022 to 2025 cohort; the older all-era calibration sample gives about 30 to 35 percent of series_b reaching C, discounted here for the window
anchors.adjustment_reason: The window ends 19 months after the as_of date and a Series C needs a median of 61 months from batch start (all eras, n=221 in time_to_milestones.csv). The probability is a small floor rather than an anchor ratio, because 3 companies in the recent cohort cannot support a rate.

bands.rationale: Series C or growth round near the 2022 and later YC median of $45M (n=9), with a flat or modest step up.
Typical growth round of $80M to $150M for a category leader with strong net retention, as seen in the larger 2022 and later rounds in the YC data.
Upside round for a category winner; the sample of 2022 and later C rounds is tiny (n=9) so this band is judgment.

ladder.why_it_fails: A Series C in the window is nearly impossible. The probability is a floor, not a forecast.

outcomes.why_it_fails: Most paths end in a stall, a pivot to a broader sales agent, or an acqui-hire, because real time coaching is a feature that conversation intelligence suites and CRMs absorb. Wingman was acquired and echo shut down, and the ones that survive (demodesk, trellus) did so by moving to adjacent products.

analogs.relevance: Real time coaching for inside sales reps from Summer 2019, the same wedge.
analogs.outcome_summary: Raised a seed and was acquired; shows the small exit typical for this wedge.

analogs.relevance: Founder led sales copilot for B2B startups, Winter 2023.
analogs.outcome_summary: Inactive in the record with no post YC round; a failure of the same founder led segment Nomi names.

analogs.relevance: AI sales assistant for playbook adoption, Summer 2022.
analogs.outcome_summary: Alive with a seed as the highest round, the standard path for this wedge.

analogs.relevance: AI coaching during parallel dialing, Winter 2022.
analogs.outcome_summary: Alive with no post YC round recorded, a slow burn.

analogs.relevance: AI powered sales coaching from Winter 2019.
analogs.outcome_summary: Alive and reached a Series A, the best result in the wedge, taking years.

killers.risk: Crowded category with funded rivals and incumbents
killers.evidence: Winn.ai, Hyperbound, Second Nature, Spiky and Gong all sell coaching, and Spiky raised $3.2M in March 2025.
killers.mitigation: Specialize in founder led and small team sales where Gong is too heavy.

killers.risk: Real time suggestions distract reps and adoption falls after trial
killers.evidence: Sales coaching products are judged on rep adoption and close rate lift, and echo (founder led copilot) shut down.
killers.mitigation: Show measured lift with a controlled trial.

killers.risk: Feature absorption by CRM and call recording tools
killers.evidence: One article notes Salesforce or HubSpot could launch similar tools, and Gong already has coaching features.
killers.mitigation: Integrate deeply into the playbook and become a revenue operations layer.

killers.risk: 12 percent close rate claim is unverified and hard to repeat
killers.evidence: The claim is from the company description with no named customer.

technical_complexity.rationale: Real time transcription, low latency suggestions from a playbook and adapting to calls are feasible with current speech and language models, and a small team can ship a Zoom or Meet overlay in three months. Latency, accuracy and not distracting the rep are the hard parts.

takeover_risk.rationale: Conversation intelligence incumbents and meeting platforms already have transcripts and can add live suggestions with the same models in about 9 months.

evidence.claim: Multiple real time sales coaching startups have raised money, showing paid demand.
Industry coverage sizes AI sales coaching at billions of dollars with incumbents adding real time features.

actions: Measure close rate lift against a control

roadmap.proof: $20K monthly recurring revenue and 80 percent seat retention

roadmap.goal: Show repeatable growth beyond founder led sales.

pros.evidence: Several real time sales coaching startups have announced rounds, including Spiky in 2025.
The pitch ties value to a measurable close rate lift, easy for buyers to test.

brand.name: Nomi
brand.name_check: python3 -I scripts/name_features.py --score "Nomi" --era 2022+ : 4 chars, 1 word, 2 syllables, kind invented_or_proper, no suffix
weaknesses: No link to sales or copilots
Common name shared with companion apps
brand.rationale: Nomi is short and pronounceable like other recent YC names but carries no meaning for sales and shares a name with other products. It is neutral for the ladder.

narrative.headline: Nomi sits in a crowded sales coaching wedge, so the seed is under even odds in 19 months and the odds do not rank it.
narrative.general_summary: Nomi sells a real time sales copilot, a wedge with funded rivals such as Winn.ai and Spiky and incumbents like Gong. The YC peers show a mixed record: wingman acquired after a seed, silkchart seeded, demodesk reached an A over years, and echo shut down. In a 19 month window the seed is about 42 percent, most likely $3M to $6M, and an A is unlikely at 8 percent given a seed.

assumptions: Window is 19 months from 2025-04-07 to 2026-11-17; seed means above about $1M from outside investors, excluding the YC deal.
Team of 5 comes from the input.
Search results dated after 2025-04-07 (Winn.ai Series A in 2026, Othello) were ignored and not used as evidence. LEAK-WEB: none naming nomi
The 12 percent close rate claim is from the company description and is unverified.
